title: (No AI) Here’s the full text of Jensen Huang’s memo to Nvidia
author: Terrence O’Brien
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/gettyimages-2285784039.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Jensen Huang, chief executive officer of Nvidia Corp., attends a media briefing following the company's "Japan AI Ecosystem" reception in Tokyo, Japan, on Thursday, July 16, 2026. Japan is planning to buy 27,500 next-generation Rubin chips from Nvidia Corp. to build a homegrown foundational AI model for robots. Photographer: Kiyoshi Ota/Bloomberg via Getty Images | Bloomberg via Getty Images

On Sunday, Nvidia announced it was [launching an investigation](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1029562/nvidia-investigating-jensen-huang-relationship-chinese-spy) into CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with Alice Huang, an AI executive and agent of the Chinese government. In addition to the Board of Directors announcing the investigation, Huang sent a memo to Nvidia employees acknowledging the affair. You can read the full text below.

> To my colleagues at NVIDIA,
> 
> I owe my family and all of you an apology.
> 
> I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry.
> 
> Throughout my life, my family has given me love and support. They deserve my honesty and loyalty. Instead, I …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1029595/full-text-jensen-huang-affair-memo-nvidia)

title: (No AI) Nvidia is investigating Jensen Huang’s relationship with a Chinese spy
author: Terrence O’Brien
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/07/STKP210_JENSEN_HUANG_A.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Nvidia has announced that it is opening an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang and his relationship with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, who was reportedly recruited by China's Ministry of State Security to [spy on the company](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1029338/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-china-spy). A [statement](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/statement-from-nvidia-board-of-directors) posted by the board of directors reads:

> The NVIDIA Board is initiating an independent investigation in light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort. A committee of independent directors, assisted by outside independent counsel, will oversee the investigation.
>
